entities.name: Harcu
entities.description: A mercenary on Shandalar hired to bring back a chest containing the key to the Onakke Catacombs; killed by an angel.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who burst in planning to hire the mercenaries to break into the viceroy's palace.

entities.name: Onakke Catacombs
entities.description: Place the chest's key was meant to open.

entities.name: The viceroy
entities.description: Ruler Liliana planned to kill at his palace.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Plane on which Harcu is a mercenary.

events.summary: Liliana Vess kicks in the door and proposes that the mercenaries handle the viceroy's guards while she kills him.
events.quote: Liliana Vess interrupted them by kicking the door down and barging in

events.summary: Harcu doubts Liliana and attacks, but an angel hunting the mercenaries fills him with golden light until he disintegrates.
events.quote: the angel filled his body with golden light until he disintegrated

relations.note: He disbelieved her and raised his sword to attack.
relations.quote: Harcu did not believe her and raised his sword to attack Liliana
